instruction: Unzip the extension file from /home/user/Desktop/ and configure it in Chrome. Verify all required extension files (manifest.json, hello.html, popup.js) are present.

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get install unzip -y && unzip /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip -d /home/user/Desktop/ && rm /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip

metadata.explanation: This task verifies that all 3 required extension files exist: manifest.json, hello.html, and popup.js. Verified from zip file contents.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete instruction coverage: Instruction requires both 'unzip extension file' AND 'configure it in Chrome', but evaluator only verifies file extraction
Missing Chrome configuration verification: Evaluator does not check if the extension is actually loaded/configured in Chrome (e.g., via chrome://extensions API)
Semantic verification gap: File presence only proves unzipping occurred, not that the extension was configured in Chrome as required
Only verifies approximately 50% of the instruction requirements - the Chrome configuration step is completely ignored
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add getter to check Chrome extensions state via Chrome DevTools Protocol or chrome://extensions page
Verify extension ID appears in loaded extensions list
Check extension is enabled/active in Chrome
Alternative: Simplify instruction to only require 'Unzip and verify files present' if Chrome configuration cannot be verified
Consider adding postconfig to open chrome://extensions page for verification
